generation.notes: Written by a sub-agent of the orchestrating Claude Code session, from the application-batch brief. NumPy only; a likelihood-ratio detector with a noise estimate that follows the clip frame by frame, a loudness gate and a spectral-flatness gate, then smoothing. One item takes about 8 ms at default settings, 3 ms at 2 seconds and 28 ms at 12 seconds with 10 ms frames; prepare.sh copies the clips from speech-transcriber v1 when present.
